name: utably-job-importer-extension
description: Utably Browser Plugin — one-click job capture and FitCheck analysis from any job board into your Utably tracker.
author: Utably

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/firefox-build.mjs && node scripts/safari-convert.mjs --optional && node scripts/prod-build.mjs --optional
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir dist/utably-browser-plugin-firefox
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir dist/utably-browser-plugin-firefox --artifacts-dir dist/signed --channel unlisted
scripts.sign:firefox:prod: npm run build && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir dist/prod/utably-browser-plugin-firefox --artifacts-dir dist/signed --channel unlisted
